Latest sharing is selected by its actual Sent revision version rather than wall-clock order. Supersession of an earlier revision is not mistaken for a delivery of it. No clock-regression acceptance claim is inferred from this query choice.

The reader returns active current items. Removed identities remain in exact retained before/after history and in underlying inactive quote items; complete business source export/recovery remains separate unfinished work.

Its resulting-agreement/acceptance/allocation view must be completed alongside the acceptance command before adoption or owner delivery.
